faqs.question: What e-commerce marketing services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer e-commerce strategy, e-commerce SEO, product page optimization, paid campaigns, retargeting and email marketing, and tracking and reporting.

faqs.question: Do you work with WordPress and Wix stores?
faqs.answer: Yes, WordPress and Wix are two of the platforms I work with.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee sales?
faqs.answer: No one can honestly guarantee sales. I focus on a clear strategy, consistent execution, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.

faqs.question: Do you run ads for products?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can plan Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns around your products and audiences.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.
